descricao: Perguntas da suíte do IPA (datasets/incident-postmortem-assistant/snapshot/data/eval/query_suite.json) adaptadas ao corpus do danluu: ids trocados para DAN-xxx; perguntas ambíguas no nosso corpus foram excluídas (lista em excluidas). Perguntas médias e difíceis têm duas variantes: a original do IPA ("causa", pois em parte já traz a causa) e uma reescrita "sintoma".

excluidas.pergunta: We found an attacker in our internal systems using credentials we forgot to rotate after a third-party breach.
excluidas.motivo: ataque com credenciais não rotacionadas: parecido com DAN-140 (comprometimento via Okta na Cloudflare)

excluidas.pergunta: Our database hit an internal transaction limit and forced itself into read-only mode to protect data.
excluidas.motivo: banco em modo somente leitura por limite interno: parecido com DAN-188 (wraparound no PostgreSQL), mas não igual

excluidas.pergunta: Packages we published to a registry were compromised because our build pipeline was hijacked through a pull request.
excluidas.motivo: pacotes publicados comprometidos: parecido com DAN-152 (ESLint no npm)

excluidas.pergunta: Our write-heavy database abruptly went read-only and nothing we restarted fixed it. The database engine itself had hit a hard internal ceiling — not disk space, not memory, not connection limits — and refused all writes until we manually cleaned up.

We discovered an attacker had been in our internal systems for days using credentials from a third-party breach months earlier. We thought we'd rotated everything, but a few service accounts we assumed were unused had been missed.
Kubernetes cluster autoscaling failure caused pod eviction cascade across three namespaces.
excluidas.motivo: autoscaling no Kubernetes: há incidentes parciais parecidos (DAN-180, 193, 210)

excluidas.pergunta: DDoS attack overwhelmed our CDN edge nodes and caused a 12-hour outage.
excluidas.motivo: DDoS em CDN: há vários DDoS no corpus (DAN-005, 011, 158, 160)

excluidas.pergunta: Container image registry was compromised through a malicious base image from an upstream vendor.
excluidas.motivo: imagem/base comprometida de fornecedor: parecido com DAN-122 (pacotes maliciosos no JCenter)
